claims.head: The Blackhawks’ goalie is in for some dangerous shots
claims.call: The Penguins’ average shot has at least their usual 6.9% chance of going in.
claims.body: The Penguins make their shots count, and the Blackhawks are near the bottom of the league at preventing dangerous shots. Expect the Penguins to get some real chances.
claims.nums: Pittsburgh 3rd for shot quality (a 6.9% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Chicago 23rd for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: The Penguins make their shots count, and the Blackhawks allow dangerous ones.

claims.head: The Penguins get in close; the Blackhawks shoot from distance
claims.body: The Penguins are the league’s best for shots from in close, at the close-range end; the Blackhawks are the league’s worst, at the long-range end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.nums: Shots from in close: Pittsburgh 1st, Chicago 32nd
claims.gist: The Penguins and the Blackhawks sit at opposite ends for shots from in close.
